title: Children with Birthday Cake in Garden, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century backyard snapshot capturing two young children posing together with a frosted birthday cake. The girl on the right holds a platter bearing the candle-topped cake while wearing a ruffled checkered sundress and sandals. The boy on the left smiles toothily in a classic horizontal-striped knit t-shirt and belted trousers. A towering ivy-draped tree trunk and sunny domestic garden frame the subjects, reflecting the post-WWII American suburban family lifestyle.
